text: こいつは　ラプラスと　いって　とても　あたまのいい　ポケモンだ！

structure.jp: ラプラスと　いって
とても　あたまのいい　ポケモンだ！

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: ラプラスと　いって
patterns.explanation: A name plus という says what something is called. Here it is in the て-form so the sentence can go on. ラプラスと　いって = 'it is called Lapras, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two statements about the same thing, like 'and'. ラプラスと　いって　とても　あたまのいい　ポケモンだ = 'it's called Lapras, and it's a very smart Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜のいい
patterns.span: あたまのいい　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: In a description placed before a thing, の can stand in for が. あたまのいい　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon whose head is good', that is, 'a smart Pokémon'.
